import geopandas as gpd
from shapely.geometry import Point, box
from shapely.ops import voronoi_diagram
from sqlalchemy import text
import pandas as pd

# Query the coordinates of all air quality stations
query = text("""
SELECT id, ST_X(coordinate::geometry) as longitude, ST_Y(coordinate::geometry) as latitude
FROM air_quality_station
""")
stations_df = pd.read_sql(query, engine)

# Convert the DataFrame to a GeoDataFrame
stations_gdf = gpd.GeoDataFrame(stations_df, geometry=gpd.points_from_xy(stations_df.longitude, stations_df.latitude), crs="EPSG:4326")

# Compute the bounding box of all station coordinates
bbox = box(stations_gdf.total_bounds[0], stations_gdf.total_bounds[1], stations_gdf.total_bounds[2], stations_gdf.total_bounds[3])

# Compute the Voronoi tessellation
voronoi = voronoi_diagram(stations_gdf.unary_union)

# Clip each Voronoi cell to the bounding box
clipped_voronoi = [cell.intersection(bbox) for cell in voronoi.geoms]

# Create a GeoDataFrame for the clipped Voronoi cells
clipped_voronoi_gdf = gpd.GeoDataFrame(geometry=clipped_voronoi, crs="EPSG:4326")

# Match each Voronoi cell to the corresponding station
clipped_voronoi_gdf['station_id'] = stations_gdf.apply(lambda row: clipped_voronoi_gdf.geometry.apply(lambda cell: cell.contains(row.geometry)).idxmax(), axis=1)

# Compute the geodesic area of each Voronoi cell in km²
clipped_voronoi_gdf['area_km2'] = clipped_voronoi_gdf.geometry.to_crs(epsg=3857).area / 1e6

# Find the Voronoi cell for the Sha Tin station (station_id 11)
shatin_cell_km2 = clipped_voronoi_gdf.loc[clipped_voronoi_gdf.station_id == 11, 'area_km2'].values[0].round(1)
